75: 	private JCMethodDecl createRecordArgslessConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode source, JCMethodDecl existingCtr) {
76: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
77: 		
78: 		java.util.List<JCVariableDecl> fields = new ArrayList<JCVariableDecl>();
79: 		for (JavacNode child : typeNode.down()) {
80: 			if (child.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
81: 				JCVariableDecl v = (JCVariableDecl) child.get();
82: 				if ((v.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
83: 					fields.add(v);
84: 				}
85: 			}
86: 		}
87: 		
88: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
89: 		
90: 		for (int i = 0; i < fields.size(); i++) {
91: 			JCVariableDecl arg = fields.get(i);
92: 			JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(GENERATED_MEMBER | Flags.PARAMETER, arg.mods.annotations);
93: 			params.append(maker.VarDef(mods, arg.name, arg.vartype, null));
94: 		}
95: 		
96: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(AccessLevel.PUBLIC) | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
97: 		JCBlock body = maker.Block(0L, List.<JCStatement>nil());
98: 		if (existingCtr == null) {
99: 			JCMethodDecl constr = maker.MethodDef(mods, typeNode.toName("<init>"), null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(), body, null);
100: 			return recursiveSetGeneratedBy(constr, source);
101: 		} else {
102: 			existingCtr.mods = mods;
103: 			existingCtr.body = body;
104: 			existingCtr = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(existingCtr, source);
105: 			addSuppressWarningsAll(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
106: 			addGenerated(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
107: 			return existingCtr;
108: 		}
109: 	}

111: 	/**
112: 	 * If the provided typeNode is a record, returns the compact constructor (there should only be one, but if the file is
113: 	 * not semantically sound there might be more). If the only one in existence is the default auto-generated one, it is removed,
114: 	 * a new explicit one is created, and that one is returned in a list.
115: 	 * 
116: 	 * Otherwise, an empty list is returned.
117: 	 */
118: 	private List<JCMethodDecl> addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode source) {
119: 		List<JCMethodDecl> answer = List.nil();
120: 		
121: 		if (typeNode == null || !(typeNode.get() instanceof JCClassDecl)) return answer;
122: 		
123: 		JCClassDecl cDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
124: 		if ((cDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) == 0) return answer;

126: 		boolean generateConstructor = false;
127: 		
128: 		JCMethodDecl existingCtr = null;
129: 		
130: 		for (JCTree def : cDecl.defs) {
131: 			if (def instanceof JCMethodDecl) {
132: 				JCMethodDecl md = (JCMethodDecl) def;
133: 				if (md.name.contentEquals("<init>")) {
134: 					if ((md.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0) {
135: 						existingCtr = md;
136: 						existingCtr.mods.flags = existingCtr.mods.flags & ~Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR;
137: 						generateConstructor = true;
138: 					} else {
139: 						if (!isTolerate(typeNode, md)) {
140: 							if ((md.mods.flags & COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR) != 0) {
141: 								generateConstructor = false;
142: 								answer = answer.prepend(md);
143: 							}
144: 						}
145: 					}
146: 				}
147: 			}
148: 		}
149: 		
150: 		if (generateConstructor) {
151: 			JCMethodDecl ctr;
152: 			if (existingCtr != null) {
153: 				ctr = createRecordArgslessConstructor(typeNode, source, existingCtr);
154: 			} else {
155: 				ctr = createRecordArgslessConstructor(typeNode, source, null);
156: 				injectMethod(typeNode, ctr);
157: 			}
158: 			answer = answer.prepend(ctr);
159: 		}

161: 		return answer;

164: 	private void addNullCheckIfNeeded(JCMethodDecl method, JavacNode paramNode, JavacNode source) {
165: 		// Possibly, if 'declaration instanceof ConstructorDeclaration', fetch declaration.constructorCall, search it for any references to our parameter,
166: 		// and if they exist, create a new method in the class: 'private static <T> T lombok$nullCheck(T expr, String msg) {if (expr == null) throw NPE; return expr;}' and
167: 		// wrap all references to it in the super/this to a call to this method.
168: 		
169: 		JCStatement nullCheck = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(generateNullCheck(source.getTreeMaker(), paramNode, source), source);
170: 		
171: 		if (nullCheck == null) {
172: 			// @NonNull applied to a primitive. Kinda pointless. Let's generate a warning.
173: 			source.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
174: 			return;
175: 		}
176: 		
177: 		List<JCStatement> statements = method.body.stats;
178: 		
179: 		String expectedName = paramNode.getName();
180: 		
181: 		/* Abort if the null check is already there, delving into try and synchronized statements */ {
182: 			List<JCStatement> stats = statements;
183: 			int idx = 0;
184: 			while (stats.size() > idx) {
185: 				JCStatement stat = stats.get(idx++);
186: 				if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat)) continue;
187: 				if (stat instanceof JCTry) {
188: 					stats = ((JCTry) stat).body.stats;
189: 					idx = 0;
190: 					continue;
191: 				}
192: 				if (stat instanceof JCSynchronized) {
193: 					stats = ((JCSynchronized) stat).body.stats;
194: 					idx = 0;
195: 					continue;
196: 				}
197: 				String varNameOfNullCheck = returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat);
198: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck == null) break;
199: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck.equals(expectedName)) return;
200: 			}
201: 		}
202: 		
203: 		List<JCStatement> tail = statements;
204: 		List<JCStatement> head = List.nil();
205: 		for (JCStatement stat : statements) {
206: 			if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat) || (JavacHandlerUtil.isGenerated(stat) && isNullCheck(stat))) {
207: 				tail = tail.tail;
208: 				head = head.prepend(stat);
209: 				continue;
210: 			}
211: 			break;
212: 		}
213: 		
214: 		List<JCStatement> newList = tail.prepend(nullCheck);
215: 		for (JCStatement stat : head) newList = newList.prepend(stat);
216: 		method.body.stats = newList;
217: 		source.getAst().setChanged();
218: 	}

220: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<NonNull> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
221: 		FlagUsageType nonNullFlagUsage = annotationNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE);
222: 		boolean nonNullAllowed = AllowHelper.isAllowable(ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE);
223: 		if (nonNullFlagUsage == null && nonNullAllowed) {
224: 			annotationNode.addError("Use of @NonNull is disabled by default. Please add '" + ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE.getKeyName() + " = " + FlagUsageType.ALLOW + "' to 'lombok.config' if you want to enable is.");
225: 		}
226: 		if (nonNullFlagUsage != null) {
227: 			String flaggedMessage = "Use of @NonNull is flagged according to lombok configuration.";
228: 			if (nonNullFlagUsage == FlagUsageType.WARNING) annotationNode.addWarning(flaggedMessage);
229: 			else if (nonNullFlagUsage == FlagUsageType.ERROR) annotationNode.addError(flaggedMessage);
230: 		}
231: 
232: 		JavacNode parentNode = annotationNode.up();
233: 		Kind parentKind = parentNode.getKind();
234: 		if (parentKind == Kind.FIELD) {
235: 			// This is meaningless unless the field is used to generate a method (@Setter, @RequiredArgsConstructor, etc),
236: 			// but in that case those handlers will take care of it. However, we DO check if the annotation is applied to
237: 			// a primitive, because those handlers trigger on any annotation named @NonNull and we only want the warning
238: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.
239: 
240: 			JCTree parentTree = parentNode.get();
241: 			JCVariableDecl fieldDecl = (JCVariableDecl) parentTree;
242: 			JCExpression fieldType = fieldDecl.vartype;
243: 			try {
244: 				if (isPrimitive(fieldType)) {
245: 					annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
246: 				}
247: 			} catch (Exception ignore) {}
248: 
249: 			JCVariableDecl fDecl = fieldDecl;
250: 			if ((fDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
251: 				// well, these kinda double as parameters (of the compact constructor), so we do some work here.
252: 
253: 				JavacNode recordTypeNode = parentNode.up();
254: 				List<JCMethodDecl> compactConstructors = addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(recordTypeNode, annotationNode);
255: 				for (JCMethodDecl ctr : compactConstructors) {
256: 					addNullCheckIfNeeded(ctr, parentNode, annotationNode);
257: 				}
258: 			}
259: 			return;
260: 		}
261: 
262: 		JCMethodDecl declaration;
263: 		JavacNode paramNode;
264: 
265: 		switch (parentKind) {
266: 		case ARGUMENT:
267: 			paramNode = parentNode;
268: 			break;
269: 		case TYPE_USE:
270: 			JavacNode typeUseNode = annotationNode.directUp();
271: 			paramNode = typeUseNode.directUp();
272: 			break;
273: 		default:
274: 			return;
275: 		}
276: 
277: 		if (paramNode.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) return;
278: 		JavacNode methodNode = paramNode.up();
279: 		try {
280: 			declaration = (JCMethodDecl) methodNode.get();
281: 		} catch (Exception e) {
282: 			return;
283: 		}
284: 
285: 		if (declaration.body == null) {
286: 			// This used to be a warning, but as @NonNull also has a documentary purpose, better to not warn about this. Since 1.16.7
287: 			return;
288: 		}
289: 
290: 		if ((declaration.mods.flags & (GENERATED_MEMBER | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR)) != 0) {
291: 			// The 'real' annotations are on the `record Foo(@NonNull Obj x)` part and we just see these
292: 			// syntax-sugared over. We deal with it on the field declaration variant, as those are always there,
293: 			// not dependent on whether you write out the compact constructor or not.
294: 			return;
295: 		}
296: 
297: 		JavacNode annotatedParameter = paramNode;
298: 		JCTree parameterTree = annotatedParameter.get();
299: 		JCVariableDecl parameterDecl = (JCVariableDecl) parameterTree;
300: 		JCExpression parameterType = parameterDecl.vartype;
301: 		if (parameterType != null && isPrimitive(parameterType)) {
302: 			annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
303: 			return;
304: 		}
305: 		addNullCheckIfNeeded(declaration, annotatedParameter, annotationNode);
306: 	}

308: 	public boolean isNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
309: 		return returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat) != null;
310: 	}
311: 	
312: 	/**
313: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
314: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
315: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
316: 	 */
317: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
318: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
319: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
320: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
321: 		
322: 		if (isExpression) {
323: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
324: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
325: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
326: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
327: 			
328: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
329: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
330: 			Name name = null;
331: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
332: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
333: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
334: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
335: 			}
336: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals("checkNotNull") && !name.contentEquals("requireNonNull"))) return null;
337: 			
338: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
339: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
340: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
341: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
342: 		}
343: 		
344: 		if (isIf) {
345: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
346: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
347: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
348: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
349: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
350: 				then = stats.get(0);
351: 			}
352: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
353: 		}
354: 		
355: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
356: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
357: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
358: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
359: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
360: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
361: 			if (isIf) {
362: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
363: 			} else {
364: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
365: 			}
366: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
367: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
368: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
369: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
370: 		}
371: 	}
